يشتعلون (form VIII)
# يَشْتَعِلُونَ (yaštaʕilūna) /jaʃ.ta.ʕi.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# يُشْتَعَلُونَ (yuštaʕalūna) /juʃ.ta.ʕa.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
